fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary and election aftermath coverage concerning Miami city commissioners and related civic disputes, alongside editorials on law enforcement practices (including gun-toting and beach policing) and municipal justice. Considerable attention is given to welcoming and entertaining visiting Lions for an upcoming convention, with extensive tourism, dining, nightlife, and travel-related content and advertisements. Mentions ongoing development and infrastructure around Biscayne Bay, including causeways and the Venetian bridge.
